text: Invariant adds TLAPS, the TLA+ Proof System, to its trusted base as a pinned tool and a separate kind of evidence (#360). A project's manifest may select ratified invariants, and the gate proves each one of the model at every size, as Spec => []Inv, from a proof the project holds. A coding agent's proof is untrusted search and the gate alone accepts it, against a theorem it writes itself, as EasyProver's acceptance does (arXiv 2610.38174). The evidence is about the model alone, reported on its own row and never folded into TLC's check within the bounds or into what the receipt says of the code. Its trust model is weaker than a kernel-checked proof's: SMT and Zenon results aren't certified, and tlapm has open soundness issues whose constructs the gate refuses. tlapm's only current build is a rolling pre-release, so its tarball is pinned by SHA-256 and a replaced asset fails the build instead of installing another tlapm.
